goal: Find the cheapest one-way flight from New York to London next Friday and give me the airline, times and price.

result.summary:
The cheapest one-way New York to London flight on Fri 23 Oct 2026 on Kayak is **$271**. It is a self-transfer itinerary on **Norse Atlantic Airways + easyJet**. It leaves JFK at **12:30 am** and arrives at Gatwick (LGW) at **11:55 pm**. It has 1 stop at Rome (FCO) with a 7h 40m layover and takes 18h 25m in total. You would have to collect and re-check your bags yourself in Rome.

If you want a normal nonstop flight, the cheapest is **JetBlue** at **$286**. It leaves JFK at 8:45 am and arrives at Heathrow (LHR) at 8:45 pm, a 7h 00m flight.
